items.t: High-voltage battery fault or won't charge
items.note: Normally covered by Tesla's battery warranty. One owner whose claim was denied was quoted about $37,000.

items.t: Windshield cracks with no clear impact
items.note: Tesla lists the glass at $1,900; owners report total bills of $2,300–$2,800 at Tesla and about $1,350 at an aftermarket shop. Insurance may cover glass.

items.job: Replace set of four 35-inch tires, mount, balance and align
items.note: Original-equipment Goodyear tires are about $470 each; off-brand all-terrains start near $175 each.

items.t: Orange rust spots on the stainless body
items.job: Remove surface rust stains and contaminants
items.note: A full clear protective film from Tesla costs about $5,000 if you want to prevent it.

items.t: Driver-assist brakes hard or drifts in lane
items.job: Clean cameras and update driver-assist software
items.note: Usually no parts needed. Tesla recommends cleaning the cameras weekly in wet weather.
